title: A routed ask or answered item shows one line on the waiting page and leaves when the owner marks it read
why: The Ask area is too crowded, and the owner rarely reads it, so asks that already have a home hide the ones that need his eyes.
note: Owner comment on the Ask area, thread b2ff97bf (09:11 CST Nov 10, relayed by the coordinator 09:14 CST): asks must not be ephemeral; each becomes a page question or a roadmap step plus a short reply. Blocked on page item 480 (ask-phase-out-rule), which asks how an ask leaves the area. Owner pick 480 a (09:14 CST Nov 10) with his note: read receipts; after the reply shows where it goes next, he marks it read (or fold) and it leaves. Shape: once an ask or an answered item is routed, it shows one line (its home, step:<slug> or item N, plus the short reply); the owner presses "Mark read" and it leaves the page; nothing is deleted, the record stays on its home. Covers the Ask area and the Answered row and section (owner comment thread 41ddef83, 09:13 CST: "this area stays here for too long too it's also done uneffectively"). Screen change in skills/waiting-page/page.html, so a designer goes first. Ready 09:16 CST Nov 10; the coordinator starts its lane. Related: page-feedback-to-template, page-thread-reply-refused. Gap (triage 10:56 CST Nov 10; folded by the coordinator 10:57 CST): a closed item leaves the page, so a thread reply that points to it leads nowhere. The owner asked "where was this question?" at 10:51 CST about item 480, which had closed and left. Fix in this step: a closed item stays as one line until the owner presses Mark read.
